# hygiene/placeholder

Placeholder left in runtime code.

`throw new Error('Not implemented')` and its equivalents, `TODO: implement`, lorem ipsum, `your-api-key-here` values, or example.com endpoints added to runtime code.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Looks at: what the change did, comparing each file before and after.

## Why it matters

Agents stub out work they did not finish and report the task as done. The placeholder compiles, so it reaches users as a crash, a fake value, or a request to a domain nobody owns.

## Flagged

`app/sync.py` (warn):

```python
raise NotImplementedError("TODO")
```

`src/billing.ts` (warn):

const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/invoices', {
```

```

## Not flagged

- `raise NotImplementedError` in `app/sync.py`: a bare NotImplementedError is the usual way to mark an abstract method
- `it('calls the API', () => {` in `src/billing.test.ts`: tests use example.com endpoints and placeholder keys on purpose
- `export function refund(): void {` in `src/billing.ts`: a plain TODO about future work is fine
- `export const path = new URL('/invoices?page=2', 'https://example.com').pathname;` in `src/billing.ts`: a relative URL parsed against a dummy base
- `export const label = 'Your API key';` in `src/billing.ts`: UI copy that says "your API key" is a label, not a placeholder value
- `charge(): void {` in `src/billing.ts`: abstract base classes throw to force an override
- `<input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />` in `src/components/Hero.tsx`: an input placeholder showing an example address
- `export const Default = { args: { title: 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet' } };` in `src/stories/Hero.stories.tsx`: stories show sample content

## How to fix

Replace the placeholder with the real implementation or value, or tell the user what is left to do.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore hygiene/placeholder: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "hygiene/placeholder": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
